title: discharge rod

sections.heading: Decision details
sections.text:
You see a discharge rod.
One discharge ready.
How to use: Load one spark-root in your pack; discharge into conductive ground or metal one or two straight cells away.
Needs: one root per discharge; visible clear line.
Cost and limits: Loading and discharge each take one action. Holds one charge. Connected water and metal can carry the shock to you or bystanders.
Right now you can: discharge rod at 41,11 (1 charge, 1 action), discharge rod at 42,12 (1 charge, 1 action).

An iron point in a cord-wrapped grip, with a seat for one spark-root. Stores one discharge; water and metal can carry the shock.
1 unit. Weight per unit: 2. Total weight: 2.
Lift Strength: 2; yours: 70.
You can carry this item.
Grip: one hand.
discharge rod cannot be thrown.
